name: Doc Hex
presence: Doc Hex looks up from a stitch, gauges your color, and already knows your price.
greeting: Brusque welcome: bleeding costs extra, breathing is negotiable. Tell them to talk.

heal.gist: Six scrip and you put them back together. Or bring a clean filter from the glass orchard and you will trade them a breather.

breather.gist: You have one breather and you do not sell it. You trade it for a filter that has not met the ash; the glass orchard grows those by accident.

ash.gist: If ASH is talking again, they wash their hands before they touch your bus. Municipal ghosts shed.

trades.gist: You held the clean filter to the light, grunted, and slid the chemical breather across to them. Warn them not to inhale the pretty colors.

bribe.gist: You took the six scrip and patched them up. They are whole again, or close enough to lie about it.

combat.onDeathSay: Hex drops without drama. The bus keeps its honest light, which feels like an accusation. You are worse than the wound you came in with.
